purpose: PR C of the Docket hosted beta (builds/beta/plan.md rev 4, approved by Cristian 2026-11-19): everything needed to run the beta on Atlas by following the README runbook, with nothing improvised. A nightly reset, a production compose file, example settings, a non-root pinned image, a load run that measured memory, a runbook and ADR-009. It also carries the fixes deferred from PR A and PR B. Nothing is deployed by this PR.
mechanism: PR B carry-ins: the gateway gives a reservation back when the transport's kill-switch read fails before any HTTP request; samples use DOCKET_MODEL_MODE (the example env sets live); the sample panel redraws the detail pane when nothing is open. PR A carry-in: in beta, a request with a non-empty ASGI root_path gets a 500 on every route and UVICORN_ROOT_PATH is a startup refusal. docket beta-reset (docket/beta_reset.py, docket/cli.py) refuses outside beta and on unsafe config; it first takes a session-level advisory lock on its own key on a connection detached from the pool and refuses with 'A reset is already running.' (exit 1) when another reset holds it, releasing it in a finally. It then takes RESET_LOCK exclusive with a lock_timeout and sets the resetting flag in beta_flags in one transaction, terminates open workflows listed from the documents table, TRUNCATEs documents, sources, events and filings, empties the bucket, prunes sign-in and per-address sample rows older than an hour (keeping the spend ledger and the day count), reseeds 12 seed-11 documents in replay mode through Ingress with no guard, waits for all 12 to end held (otherwise the reset fails), then clears the flag; the flag's updated_at is the last reset time. A failed reset leaves the flag set. The reset service runs it at 08:00 UTC and at startup when a reset is due (flag stuck or none today), retrying every 5 minutes after a failure. Samples take RESET_LOCK shared and read the flag inside Ingress persist's transaction through an optional guard; a resetting state answers 503 with its own text. In beta /healthz reports resetting and last_reset_age_seconds. The worker's gateway cache is an LRU of 10,000, transports shared per provider and model; the per-document run cap lives in worker memory and starts fresh after eviction or a restart, with the daily ledger as the hard bound. A refund the database cannot write fails closed and is logged. compose.prod.yaml: six long-running services plus migrate and temporal-data-init one-shots, memory and CPU limits, restart unless-stopped, healthchecks, log rotation, only the API published on 127.0.0.1:${DOCKET_PORT:-8001}, every secret required with ${VAR:?}, the Anthropic key only on the worker, SeaweedFS identities written from env by its entrypoint, uvicorn --no-proxy-headers; every command uses --env-file .env.beta. .env.beta.example names every beta setting with placeholders the startup refusals reject. Dockerfile: app stages run as uid 10001, bases pinned by multi-arch digest, the browser stage stays root; .dockerignore keeps .env.beta.example. scripts/check_prod_compose.py checks the rendered compose and prints no values on success or policy failure. scripts/load runs 60 samples from 4 addresses against a local stub provider under its own compose project (docket-load) and image tag, refuses unless the worker points at the stub, and exits non-zero unless every sample settled, the reset succeeded and stats were collected. README runbook: Caddy block, caddy validate and rollback, start, check, switch off and on, manual reset with compose run --rm, backups with pipefail and a temp file. ADR-009 records the Temporal dev server choice, the measured peaks (1.4 GB of 3.3 GB) and what production would need.
decisions: The reset flag and time live in beta_flags, so no migration. The reset-versus-sample guard is a transaction-scoped lock held only around the document insert, because a lock across the whole request starved the pool. Overlapping resets refuse rather than wait, because waiting runs a second full reset for no gain. The per-document run cap stays best effort (Cristian's call via the orchestrator 2026-11-20): a guarantee needs per-document spend in Postgres. Samples are not pinned to live; one setting decides the model mode. The load run needs no cap raise: 4 addresses x 15 stays under the caps. Accepted leftovers per reset race: one failed Temporal workflow and at most one orphan raw/ object, recorded in ADR-009.
readers: README.md runbook: the operator deploying and running the beta on Atlas. docs/operations.md: people running Docket locally or as the beta. docs/adr/009-hosting.md: reviewers judging the hosting choice. .env.beta.example and compose.prod.yaml comments: the operator configuring it. Comments in docket/*.py, scripts/*.py and web/src/main.ts: the next maintainer.
